_about: A slam's crater by material (docs/world/craters-by-material.md; read by sim/world/craters.gd). Combat's numbers, copied from docs/combat/biomes.md section 4.3 and its park's ground_atoms.json craters (Combat and Choreography, 2026-10-23; ruled by Game Design, rulings 2026-10-23b item 3). enabled: the whole module (off: contact.gd's slam digs today's bowl and the state is as it was, the golden and every replay byte for byte). touchBuilt: the rows of the five built classes (paving, rock, soil, sand, rubble) apply only with it on (biomes.md section 1 rule 2), so a gen 1 or hand-made world plays as today even with the module on. embedThresholdScales: an embed's threshold (contact.json embed) is multiplied by the row's depth, so the embed rate is today's on every surface (ruling 3). A row is keyed by the look class the slam lands on (WorldContact.lookAt, the beam strips included); a class without a row digs today's bowl. radius, depth, rim: multipliers on today's bowl radius, depth and rim crest; steep: the bowl wall's shape (1 today; above 1 a flatter floor and steeper walls, below 1 a slacker bowl). refill and refillTicks: the share of the depth that fills back, over that many ticks (an aftermath job, after.gd). embedMul: how deep an embedded body sits, times the bowl's depth (a look, not a rate). fill: water stands in the bowl, to the biome's water table (water) or, within seaCols of open water, to the sea (waterNearSea). breakThrough: on sea ice, a bowl whose floor reaches below the sea breaks the floe and opens water under him (the same cut as the FLOE SPLIT aftermath). cracks (Rendering's decal), ejecta (VFX's), rimKind, treesLean and glowTicks are carried for the crater_shape event only; the sim never reads them.

struggleMeet._note: Where a beam struggle does its damage: the meeting point (docs/world/struggle-meet.md; numbers from Game Design, docs/design/power-scale.md 'By stage, as data for World'; Legal RL-232, RL-242, RL-243, RL-246). Read by sim/world/struggle_meet.gd, apart from the module's switch. Off: nothing calls it and a match is as it was. energy: each beam brings its fighter's energy times its stage share (E(level) x stage / count); E_meet is the two added, times sigMul if either is a signature. fEnd: the share of E_meet dug by the ending (overwhelm and letGo are times the run's share of fullRunSec). The bowl is radius.k x sqrt(dug energy), its depth depthShare of it, dug once under the point by the special dig. heightReach: the energy is cut by 1 - height / (ofRadius x the radius before the cut), height the point's lowest above the ground in the last second; above the reach it is an air burst (no bowl). minE: under it a dent, so a scorch instead. perPulse: no digging while it runs. during: the ring at the point grows from ringFromBh to ringToBh body heights, at most one every ringMinGapSec, and the buildings inside it take the beam's damage. wave: the radius is the crater's (radiusOfCrater); fallReach: the share of the radius inside which a building falls, dent: the hit points a building takes from there to the lip, falling to nothing at the lip, keep: the share a building past the level cap is left at; glassHpShare: a tower within the radius before the height cut is taken to this share of its hit points (windows out, stage 1: keep it under stages.json hpAt[0]); bodyHeight: units. overwhelmCarve: the winner's beam carves from the point outward (Encounter's); carveAlongBeams false: the beams carve nothing from the moment their fronts meet (Encounter's).
